niche_statement: Fractional technical-operations leader for 20-200-person regulated B2B SaaS companies and game studios whose growth has outrun the ops layer - engaged when builds depend on one person, cloud spend drifts unowned, and an enterprise buyer, auditor, or PE board demands SOC 2/CJIS evidence and cost visibility - owning the platform/DevSecOps/FinOps layer underneath the CTO, per his record at Expedia (0-95), Pokemon (2-32, 320M users), Prytania Media (0-35, 4 studios), and Lexipol (first-attempt SOC 2 Type II, -22% AWS).
edp: Unowned technical operations silently converts runway into waste: cloud bills that double in six months unflagged, ~20%+ recoverable cloud spend (he cut AWS 22% at Lexipol), and enterprise deals frozen pending SOC 2 - costing a 20-200-person company months of runway before the problem appears as a board-visible line item.
expertise_statements: Achieve SOC 2 Type II certification without slowing an aggressive product roadmap
Own our AWS spend and put FinOps guardrails and cost visibility in place
Standardize CI/CD pipelines currently maintained by a single engineer
Build an internal developer platform with self-service provisioning and role-based access
Stand up observability, on-call rotation, and incident response to reduce MTTR
Centralize identity and access management (SSO, RBAC) across a fast-growing team
Consolidate fragmented DevOps tooling and delivery workflows across multiple teams or business units
Be our first dedicated DevOps or platform hire so senior engineers can return to product work
Prepare our environment for CJIS, NIST, or SOC 2 audits and enterprise security reviews
Stabilize Unreal or Unity build and release pipelines for a growing game studio
Build a shared services or central platform engineering function from scratch
Rationalize SaaS licensing and vendor contracts to cut operating spend
Integrate tooling, identity, and delivery workflows after an acquisition
Produce the cost and delivery reporting our board and investors are asking for
Unblock enterprise procurement stalled on security questionnaires and compliance evidence
Scale DevSecOps in a PE-backed, regulated SaaS environment
Establish 24x7 operations and reliability standards for a consumer-scale platform
Bring cloud infrastructure costs that have drifted without ownership back under control
disqualifiers: staffing agency or recruiting firm posting on behalf of clients
managed service provider or DevOps consultancy (they sell what he sells)
active government security clearance required (TS/SCI or Secret)
healthcare clinical integration roles (Epic, HL7, EHR) - not his domain
hardware, embedded, or on-premise-only infrastructure with no cloud footprint
mature platform organization hiring expansion headcount into an existing large platform team
role explicitly scoped as hands-on staff-level IC only with no ownership of the ops layer
